title: OpenDesk — Seed Report
description: Platform data seeding health (SPEC-W17 §8.7): last-run completion and per-table rowcounts from cac.seed_run_log in the analytics_meta Postgres database. A healthy full run shows 7 logged tables; lgas=774, wards=8812, channels=32, channel_unit_costs=768 (32x24), fx_series>=365, agents/customers scale with SEED_SCALE. NOTE: the W17 spec path infra/grafana/dashboards/ maps to this provisioning dir (infra/observability/dashboards — see grafana/provisioning/dashboards/dashboards.yml). Requires the provisioned 'opendesk-postgres' datasource.

panels.title: Last seed run
panels.description: Most recent seeded_at across cac.seed_run_log. Red when older than the staging refresh trigger (§8.6: 24h).

targets.rawSql: SELECT max(seeded_at) AS last_run FROM cac.seed_run_log

panels.title: Seed tables logged
panels.description: Distinct tables in cac.seed_run_log. A complete 9-step bootstrap logs 7 data tables (lgas, wards, channels, channel_unit_costs, agents, customers, fx_series).

targets.rawSql: SELECT count(*) AS logged FROM cac.seed_run_log

panels.title: cac schema tables present
panels.description: Contract-D tables existing in schema cac (8 expected). Anything less = apply sql/postgres/ddl (bootstrap step 1).

targets.rawSql: SELECT count(*) AS present FROM information_schema.tables WHERE table_schema = 'cac'

panels.title: Non-synthetic rows in seed tables
panels.description: §8.8 compliance: every cac.* row must carry is_synthetic=true. MUST be 0 — anything else is a compliance incident (run collision_guard.py + investigate).

targets.rawSql: SELECT (SELECT count(*) FROM cac.lgas WHERE NOT is_synthetic) + (SELECT count(*) FROM cac.wards WHERE NOT is_synthetic) + (SELECT count(*) FROM cac.channels WHERE NOT is_synthetic) + (SELECT count(*) FROM cac.channel_unit_costs WHERE NOT is_synthetic) + (SELECT count(*) FROM cac.agents WHERE NOT is_synthetic) + (SELECT count(*) FROM cac.customers WHERE NOT is_synthetic) + (SELECT count(*) FROM cac.fx_series WHERE NOT is_synthetic) AS non_synthetic

panels.title: seed_report_summary
panels.description: Last-run completion per table: rowcount as logged by _lib.log_seed_run, run timestamp, runner and git sha — straight from cac.seed_run_log.

targets.rawSql: SELECT table_name, rowcount, seeded_at AS last_run_at, runner_id, git_sha FROM cac.seed_run_log ORDER BY table_name

panels.title: Rows per seed table
panels.description: Per-table rowcounts from cac.seed_run_log. Reference expectations: lgas 774, wards 8,812, channels 32, channel_unit_costs 768, fx_series >=365; agents=5,000xSEED_SCALE, customers=200,000xSEED_SCALE.

targets.rawSql: SELECT table_name, rowcount FROM cac.seed_run_log ORDER BY rowcount DESC
